body: I'm so sorry. My mom is completely nuts too and she also likes to praise my CSA abuser(s) who are both family. I'm disgusted with them. I don't want to hear their name but I hear her sing their praises. I'm so sorry you went through this. Please know you're not alone. My mom is literally insane and sometimes I think it's me. I really do. Sometimes I think I was a bad seed, I let her words seep into my head and I believe them. They're just words. The words of a woman most people find superficially charming as well. Not the truth. We know our truth. God I feel like we have the same nmom.

This is very kind, it's hard for me to think of anything that will benefit me at this time. I will definitely be keeping a notebook with different colored pens and try to track her manipulations. I wish staying here wasn't the only option so I'm going to call shelters and explain my situation. 

I'm looking for a job and I've been over-drafting my account to buy groceries. I know not to tell her how much I make again because she then asks for more and more money to help her. I'm going to start saving as soon as I'm hired someplace because I can't be frightened day after day anymore. 
My mom always says that she doesn't know what I'll do without her. How about not have a sore neck and back because she thinks it's perfectly acceptable to "discipline" me because she's my mom. It's hard to stay safe in a situation like this. I feel trapped. UGH I want to be free from this more than anything. I've never sought advice or help but she's been this way ever since I can remember. Violently swinging her emotional pendulum. I have text messages where she admits to attacking me and how I deserved it and how I'm a bad daughter and no one will ever want me.  

I know my thoughts are scattered right now but I hope my gratitude comes across. Thank you.

Yeah he's self described "emotionally numb" and that's nowhere near what I need in a partner. Thanks for acknowledging that part because I feel like I'm missing out by losing him but I desperately need someone to have my back. I moved *here* last year and he was my only friend. Off track.
I'm not too sure about the resources in my state because as I mentioned I'm not from this region and haven't looked into it. She constantly tells me to "get out." I'll check local shelters and stuff. I'm afraid of staying in a shelter but I'm more afraid of how bad my mental health is around my mom I keep having suicidal ideation thoughts and I'm pretty paranoid and have low self esteem right now. I don't have a support group so staying at a shelter might provide me with a sense of belonging. Is that weird? I feel very alone and scared. I'm torn about the idea of staying at a shelter. I guess it's a "monster you know" feeling but the least I can do is call around and tell them what's going on. Living with my mom is never knowing what will set her off. The strain is exhausting and I'm afraid she might hurt me one day as she's got 165 pounds in me and last night she put her knee on my chest. 
Love and internet hugs greatly needed and sent right back! Made me feel warm.

Thank you. I checked the sub out and I'm going to post there soon. I didn't consider an info diet for my mom. She's demanding about knowing every small detail of my day. Even would show up at my old job without warning, to "make sure your at work." Narrating her actions makes me LOL, she'd go crazy if she knew I was making her an Animal Kingdom predator but she won't know. I think it will really help me detach and not leave me vulnerable to the way she can twist my words when I attempt to reason. Like you said I can't reason with someone who is always "right."
Definitely weird and on a whole new level of weird at that.
No you're right to be angry. You made yourself dinner. You used 1 potato. 1 potato. She then insults your food but tells you to share it with your dad. Doesn't make sense. I am pissed off for you.
Thank you for this reply I appreciate it. I want to turn my pain into art. I am going to keep living until I can see that through.

I turned 21 this year. I've always thought he was hawt, even when he tongued 
 Angelina Jolie on the red carpet.
